## Problem

What user or maintainer problem should this solve?

## Proposed change

Describe the smallest useful behavior and its boundaries.

## Safety and evidence impact

Explain how the proposal preserves authorization, passive-only collection,
privacy minimization, provenance, and Docker isolation.

## Alternatives and validation

What existing behavior or standard feature was considered? How could this be
validated without intrusive collection?
